transport_scope.shape: N x F for each dataset
transport_scope.not_compressed: A_hat H1 and the output layer
transport_scope.rank_validity: F>128 for all three datasets; rank 128 applies only to M0

selection.jacobian: analytic derivative of frozen ANN logits with respect to a transported message entry using the ReLU hidden mask and normalized adjacency column norm
selection.granularity: one global coefficient set per dataset and checkpoint seed over the full transductive graph message
selection.access: uses full graph adjacency/features and frozen model outputs/hidden mask, not labels; test features are part of the transductive graph
selection.tie_rule: implementation uses numpy argpartition with no additional semantic tie-break

budget_and_cost.budget_definition: fraction of residual message entries selected
budget_and_cost.matching_scope: identical total_padded_bits within each dataset/seed/rank/budget among matched residual controls; full-float and SVD-only are references outside this matched residual budget

rate_conversion.operation: clip hidden at zero, per-hidden-dimension maximum theta, round count=rint(hidden/theta*T), decode count*theta/T
rate_conversion.jacobian_model: frozen ANN logits, not the rate-coded converted model

comparators.fidelity_headline: post-hoc strongest evaluated matched-budget non-proposed residual control by three-seed mean logit MSE per dataset; top_abs is best on all three reported datasets
comparators.task_observation: best matched-budget non-proposed residual control per dataset/seed/metric; report maximum observed degradation, not a bound

validation_test_chronology.validation_grid: ranks 16/32/64/128 and residual budgets 0.5/1/2% were evaluated on validation
validation_test_chronology.focal_fix: guidance-v3 fixed rank128 and 2% after validation exposure and before the confirmation test run
validation_test_chronology.test_status: held-out confirmation after validation exposure; not preregistered or independent replication

timing.condition: rank128/1%, not the focal 2% fidelity setting
timing.p95_convention: for each method/dataset/seed, numpy quantile 0.95 over seven measured elapsed times after three warmups; headline ratio is method p95 divided by SVD-only p95
timing.cuda: synchronize before and after each timed call; reset peak allocation before each call
timing.scope: basis construction, residual construction/selection, reconstruction, rate conversion, and evaluation with frozen model/adjacency/features precomputed
